name: FPV UAV video saliency dataset and benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark for evaluating video saliency prediction methods on first-person view UAV (aerial) videos.
evaluation_method: AUC / NSS / CC (standard video saliency metrics)
notes: Specialized first-person UAV (aerial) viewpoint data; not an LLM benchmark. Likely a relatively small, domain-specific dataset with potential viewpoint and context bias; standard saliency metrics (AUC/NSS/CC) are used for evaluation.
